task_description: Fix the More -> PDF Export Annual Report producing a blank (template-only, no data) PDF. Root cause: mgmt/backend/src/index.js convertDocxToPdfBulk handler forwards req.base64 (undefined) instead of req.data as the placeholder-set argument to dispatchBulkPdfConvert, so the Render pdf_convert job fills the report template with an empty object and every loop/scalar renders blank. Fix: forward req.data; add prove-first tests (handler wiring contract, Render-job data preservation, Render loop fill). Keep existing suites green. User must redeploy the mgmt Worker for the fix to take effect.

verification.summary: No compile step (plain ESM). Backend suite 1086 pass / 0 fail (1079 baseline + 7 new). Render suite 203 pass / 0 fail (199 baseline + 4 new, incl. docxRender parity/drift test). Test quality verified by reading the tests: pdf-export-report-data.test.mjs drives the REAL dispatchBulkPdfConvert, captures the outbound Render pdf_convert job via a fetch stub matching renderJobs.createAndDispatchJob's POST /jobs contract, and deep-equals payload.data against the full non-empty placeholder object (arrays intact) + a control pinning the {} symptom; report-loops-fill.test.mjs builds a real .docx with PizZip and asserts the actual fillDocxTemplateFromBase64/FromBytes renders loop rows for a non-empty array and the {^contributors} fallback for empty/{}; pdf-export-bulk-data-wiring.test.mjs is a source-level contract that fails if the handler is reverted to req.base64 (coder confirmed the revert-check). docker_build skipped: no deploy creds; validation is host-based per environment constraints.
